=== Jenkinsfile (groovy-declarative)
# Imported from Jenkinsfile by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
pipeline: pipeline
on:
  push: {branches: ['*'], tags: ['*']}
  schedule:
    - {cron: 0 4 * * 1-5}
inputs:
  target: {description: Where to deploy, default: dev}
  verbose: {type: boolean, default: false}
  region: {type: choice, description: Region, options: [eu, us]}
steps:
  build:
    image: golang:1.22
    timeout: 30m
    retry: 2
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
    run: |
      go build ./...
      echo build ${LAUNCHWAY_RUN_NUMBER} on $LAUNCHWAY_BRANCH
      echo ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET} ${someGroovy.call()}
      (
        cd web
        npm ci
      )
      (
        export CI=true
        npm test
      )
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: a Windows command ran here'; exit 1
      # NEEDS A PERSON: Groovy code was here:
      # def x = 1
      #           echo "x ${x}"
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: a script block ran here'; exit 1
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: files were passed between stages here'; exit 1
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: the plug-in step slackSend ran here'; exit 1
    reports:
      tests: [reports/*.xml, reports/**/*.xml]
    artifacts:
      - {name: build, paths: [bin, web/dist], when: always}
  build-post-failure:
    image: golang:1.22
    needs: build
    when: {upstream: failed}
    on_failure: continue
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
    run: |
      echo failed
  lint:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: build
    timeout: 30m
    retry: 2
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
    run: |
      golangci-lint run
  unit:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: build
    when: {branch: [main, release-*]}
    timeout: 5m
    retry: 3
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
    run: |
      go test ./...
      flaky.sh
  matrix:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: [lint, unit]
    timeout: 30m
    retry: 2
    for_each:
      platform: [linux, mac]
      go: ["1.21", "1.22"]
    exclude:
      - {go: "1.21", platform: mac}
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
      PLATFORM: {each: platform}
      GO: {each: go}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
    run: |
      echo $PLATFORM $GO
  release-approval:
    kind: approval
    needs: matrix
    message: Release now?
  release:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: [release-approval, matrix]
    timeout: 30m
    retry: 2
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
      TOKEN: {store: vault, key: deploy-token, field: value}
    run: |
      kubectl apply -f deploy.yaml
  tagged:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: release
    timeout: 30m
    retry: 2
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
    run: |
      echo tagged
  inner-one:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: tagged
    timeout: 30m
    retry: 2
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
    run: |
      echo 1
  inner-two:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: inner-one
    timeout: 30m
    retry: 2
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
    run: |
      echo 2
  pipeline-post-always:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: inner-two
    when: {upstream: always}
    on_failure: continue
    env:
      APP: shop
      GREETING: hello ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
    secrets:
      REG: {store: vault, key: registry-login, field: value}
    run: |
      echo done
